description: This bar chart, titled "Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time Scaling," presents performance comparisons across six subplots (a-f) for different large language models on two benchmarks: MATH-500 and AIME24. The horizontal axis in each subplot represents model size categories (3B, 405B, 1.5B, 671B, 7B, unk), while the vertical axis represents performance scores, scaled linearly from 0 to 100 for MATH-500 plots (a-c) and from 0 to 90 for AIME24 plots (d-f). The legend identifies seven model variants: CoT (white), Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (blue diagonal stripes), Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (green), o1-mini (pink), DeepSeek-R1 (yellow), o1-preview (brown), and o1 (grey). Each bar's height corresponds to its performance score, with exact values labeled atop each bar. In subplot (a), the CoT model achieves 78.2, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct achieves 74.6, and Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct achieves 71.4. In subplot (b), the DeepSeek-R1 model achieves 91.6, o1-mini achieves 90.0, and o1-preview achieves 85.5. In subplot (c), the DeepSeek-R1 model achieves 97.3, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B achieves 95.2, and o1 achieves 94.8. In subplot (d), the Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct model achieves 30.0, Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct achieves 23.3, and o1-preview achieves 9.3. In subplot (e), the o1-mini model achieves 63.6, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B achieves 63.3, and o1-preview achieves 44.6. In subplot (f), the DeepSeek-R1 model achieves 83.3, o1-mini achieves 79.8, and o1 achieves 79.2. The bars are not sorted by height, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and labeling.
